{{Quote|I didn't even think Jedi were real until last week. Is it true they steal babies?''"<br />"''Yeah. And cut women in half with their laser swords&hellip;|Two Jabiimi soldiers|<ref name="Republic 55" />}}
A [[Jabiimi]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a '''soldier''' in the [[Nationalist Army]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] during the [[Battle of Jabiim]] between the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] and the [[Jabiimi Nationalists]]. He was stationed at the trenches of [[Outpost Shear]], where he and his fellow [[Unidentified Jabiimi soldier 2|soldier]] exchanged [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|Anti-Jedi]] talk. As they heard the approach of the first-generation [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], they took cover in their trench.<ref name="Republic 55" />

During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attack on the outpost, he was badly wounded by the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]]. As the Republic forces overran the main emplacement, he was found lying on the ground by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sirrus]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Aubrie Wyn]], one of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] best [[Jedi healer/Legends|healers]]. On her Master's motion, Wyn [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] him.<ref name="Republic 55" />

The [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] had a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hair/Legends|beard]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. During the attack, he wore the blue [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] of Nationalist [[Army/Legends|Army]] personnel.<ref name="Republic 55" />
